1: Late night in LA, a cab waits for its fare. Then a man drops down onto it.
2: That night, the passenger in an ordinary cabbie's car was a hired killer.
3: At LA airport, a man in a gray suit and sunglasses swaps bags with a stranger and disappears. He would be Max's fare tonight.
4: At the cab company garage. Max wipes his taxi clean again today.
5: Max has driven a cab in LA for twelve years, and he tucks a photo of a tropical island in front of the driver's seat.
6: Max's cab rolls down the sunset-lit streets of LA. Tonight begins like any other day.
7: His first fare that night is Annie, a federal prosecutor. Max makes a bet with her over the route.
8: Annie tells Max she played a string instrument in high school, opening up to a driver she has just met.
9: Max talks about the limo company he plans to start someday.
10: He says it will be a car so nice you won't want to get out even at the airport. Judging only by how Annie is dressed, Max tries to guess what she does for a living.
11: Annie is nervous about tomorrow's first trial, and Max tells her he has a getaway of his own.
12: As she gets out, Annie hands Max her business card.
13: Holding Annie's card, Max smiles quietly to himself.
14: Then comes the next fare: a man in a gray suit, Vincent.
15: Max explains his route, saying it takes seven minutes. Vincent admits that he does not like LA.
16: Vincent asks how many years Max has been a driver, and Max answers twelve, though it's only temporary work.
17: Vincent says he has five stops to make tonight and offers Max $600 to drive him until dawn.
18: Max waits behind the building. Vincent goes to see the man in an upstairs room. Then, with a crash, that man plunges onto the cab.
19: Holding Max at gunpoint, Vincent presses him to open the trunk.
20: Vincent loads the body into the trunk. Max begs him to just take the cab.
21: Vincent climbs back into the cab, and the taxi pulls out of the dark alley.
22: Meanwhile, Fanning, a narcotics detective, arrives at the apartment where the body fell.
23: The dead man was his informant.
24: Inside the cab, Vincent says calmly, as if it were nothing, that one man dying isn't such a big deal.
26: The cab with the broken windshield gets pulled over by the police.
27: The officer peers inside the cab. He also looks over the cracked windshield.
28: The cops hurry off, and Max can finally breathe.
29: Vincent ties Max's hands to the steering wheel.
30: Vincent gets out to find his second target, and Max, left alone, looks around.
31: Max shouts for help. Out past the alley, men are walking by.
32: At the sound of gunfire, Max ducks his head. The two robbers lie dead from Vincent's gun.
33: The two stop at a gas station, where Vincent warns Max that drawing attention only gets innocent people killed.
34: Meanwhile, Fanning examines the crime scene.

36: Daniel tells the story of the night he played with Miles Davis.
37: But Daniel's face freezes at what Vincent says next: he is the third target.
38: Daniel desperately answers the quiz, but Vincent finally pulls the trigger.
39: If Max skips his hospital visit, his mother will call the cab company.

49: Vincent asks Max, who has been in a temporary job for twelve years, why he still hasn't started.

63: Fanning tries to lead Max out.
